verdict.rationale: Better Auth calls itself an authentication and authorization framework. Its organization plugin documents assigning roles and permissions plus built-in access control, and a community commenter confirms RBAC support. That gives permission-level control somewhat beyond bare roles, but nothing shows resource-level, relationship-based or policy-based authorization. Missing for 10: resource-scoped permission checks, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy/attribute-based (ABAC) rule definitions, documentation of a permission-statement model, and independent hands-on corroboration of fine-grained authorization.
